verdict.rationale: GitLab documents Personal Access Tokens, SSH keys, and API access as ways to authenticate for programmatic/automated use (gitlab-docs-5, gitlab-docs-6, gitlab-docs-10), which is the general mechanism a buyer would use to issue credentials to an agent, and GitLab is known to support scoped tokens at project/group level. However, the evidence pack gives only title-level references with no detail on scope granularity, agent-specific token types, or least-privilege configuration guidance for AI agents specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of token scope options, agent-specific credential issuance workflow, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that scoping works as intended for AI agent use cases.
